title: Giacché a morir vicini
subtitle: Don Alfonso, Fiordiligi, Dorabella, Despina, Ferrando and Guglielmo: Act 1 finale (No. 18), section 3, from Così fan tutte

passages.label: Giacchè a morir vicini · Gente, accorrete · Chi mi chiama? · Cosa vedo
Ah che pur troppo è vero · Abbandonar i miseri · Cosa possiam mai far · Di vita ancor dan segno
Dei, che cimento è questo · Più bella comediola
Sospiran gli infelici · Che figure interessanti · Ed il polso?
Ah se tarda ancor l'aita · Più domestiche e trattabili · Poverini (to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 15, No. 18 Finale, section 3 of 6

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: Giacchè, “Nessuno o Dio ci sente” (the libretto has oddio), pur troppo as two words, Dorabella's fredissima (the libretto has freddissima), gliel', Fiordiligi's added “si” in bar 145, and fate un po without its apostrophe.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 159–168, bars 138–291 of No. 18
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the No. 18 Finale (697 bars) read in fifteen page ranges, sung lines and piano each by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the zoomed page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by nine fresh proofreaders (three fixes on pages 148–154, the rest clean). The German singing translation is left out. All the singers of this section have a staff throughout, with rests where the print leaves a staff out; singers who do not sing in this section are left out. Cut from the one-file finale at bars 138–291: from the change to E flat (Don Alfonso's “Giacchè a morir vicini”, no new tempo word printed: the Allegro continues, so “Allegro” is restated here) to the double bar before the Allegro in 3/4. Playback tempo ♩ = 166 from René Jacobs's recording (harmonia mundi), whose track for bars 1–291 lasts 7:35.
